title: Full Automation
body:
# Full Automation
**CREATE. INDUSTRIALIZE. AUTOMATE.**

> A tech modpack taking you from the stone age to advanced quantum technology!

**Full Automation** combines the most powerful and fun tech mods to let you advance your little civilization from Vanilla to **particle accelerators**, **black holes** and **nuclear energy**.

## Advance Through Ages
**MACHINES CREATE MACHINES**

| Age of | Mods | Features |
|--------|------|----------|
| **Iron**  | Vanilla |  |
| **Brass** | Create | Mechanical Contraptions |
| **Steel**  | Create + Immersive Engineering | Industrial Machines |
| **Electricity** | Immersive Engineering + Mekanism | Small Effective Machines |
| **Uranium** | Oritech + Mekanism + AE2 | Powerful Machines & Nuclear Power |

## Everything Is Connected
Different technologies and types for energy are mutually compatible, letting you connect your machines in all new ways!

## Key Mods:
- Create (+ addons)
- Create Aeronautics
- Immersive Engineering
- Applied Energistics 2
- Mekanism
- Oritech

## Roadmap
- Tweak recipes for better progression through ages
- Custom achievements/guides to guide progression
- Include other mods and addons, especially for QoL
